create_blender_dataset: create a BlenderDataset instance to load Blender scene data with rays and RGB colors for training
load_blender_metadata: load Blender scene metadata from transforms JSON files including camera poses and image paths
compute_ray_directions: compute normalized ray directions for all pixels using focal length and image dimensions
convert_world_to_ndc: convert 3D world coordinates to normalized device coordinates using scene center and radius
sample_rays_and_rgbs: sample ray origins, directions, and RGB colors from the dataset for a given index
